purpose: Equation-based friction, SI-identifiability and mechanism-transfer evaluation
weights: Frozen original video epoch-40 checkpoint and frozen RK4 physical-state component checkpoint
pairing: Same initial crank angle, initial crank speed and constant motor torque for each seed in every condition
camera: Same calibrated camera and normalization as source training
new_mechanism: 3R+1P crank-slider, same crank/coupler lengths, slider mass equals the source rocker mass, known target constraints provided
gate_basis: Five times the fixed 20 micrometre data-audit bound, selected before model evaluation; not a universal benchmark tolerance
primary_metric: Equivalent crank motor torque error gamma^T(M a+c+G-Q_ext-Q_fric)-tau_A in N*m, gamma=dq/dtheta and gamma_1=1
equation_terms: Inertia, velocity-quadratic, gravity, friction, external force and motor torque reported separately

friction_probe.method: Matched +/- speed, same pose and torque; odd acceleration isolates friction

inertia_probe.method: I_eff=1/(d alpha/d tau); reject nonpositive gains explicitly

parameter_control.method: Independent physical regressor with exact states, nonnegative least squares; audit rank before interpreting individual masses/friction coefficients

SI_mass_policy: Native point masses have a mass/potential/input-map scale gauge. Report this structural nonidentifiability, and separately evaluate behavior-implied SI inertia; do not call raw parameters identified SI body masses.
scope: Video model sees three prefix images and the constant action. State component sees exact prefix state and is explicitly a diagnostic.
Mass, inertia and friction truth are evaluator-only, never model inputs.
Cross-topology test adapts only the given geometric constraint callback with identical learned weights and dimensions.
Target mechanism training, topology discovery, Delta/Stewart coverage and multi-seed training claims are not included.
Parameter controls using ground-truth states verify excitation/identifiability; they are not video-learning model scores.
